rfpp_coverage: SELECT count(*) AS requests,min(request_timestamp) AS first_request,max(request_timestamp) AS last_request,min(collected_at) AS first_collection,max(collected_at) AS last_collection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE request_timestamp >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS requests_from_nominal_dump_cutoff,count(*) FILTER(WHERE requested_intent->>'status'='chronology_uncertain') AS chronology_uncertain FROM analysis.rfpp_request
event_coverage: SELECT log_type,count(*) AS event_rows,count(DISTINCT log_id) AS log_rows,min(ts) AS first_event,max(ts) AS last_event,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ts>='2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS events_from_nominal_cutoff FROM analysis.protect_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
api_coverage: SELECT log_type,count(*) AS api_rows,min(ts) AS first_event,max(ts) AS last_event,min(collected_at) AS first_collection,max(collected_at) AS last_collection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE api_logpage IS DISTINCT FROM api_pageid AND api_logpage IS NOT NULL AND api_pageid IS NOT NULL) AS differing_nonnull_ids,count(*) FILTER(WHERE action_hidden OR user_hidden OR comment_hidden OR suppressed) AS hidden_metadata_rows FROM analysis.protect_log_api GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
event_resolution: SELECT resolution_method,count(*) AS event_rows,count(DISTINCT log_id) AS log_rows FROM analysis.protect_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
event_uncertainty: SELECT level_source,count(*) AS event_rows,count(DISTINCT log_id) AS log_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_opening) AS opening_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_opening AND NOT is_indefinite AND expiry IS NULL) AS unknown_expiry,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_opening AND page_id IS NULL) AS unresolved_openings FROM analysis.protect_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
episode_coverage: SELECT count(*) AS episodes,min(start_ts) AS first_start,max(start_ts) AS last_start,max(actual_end_ts) AS last_observed_end,count(*) FILTER(WHERE start_ts>='2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS starts_after_nominal_cutoff,count(*) FILTER(WHERE actual_end_ts>'2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS ends_after_nominal_cutoff,count(*) FILTER(WHERE expiry_unknown) AS unknown_expiry,count(*) FILTER(WHERE actual_end_ts<start_ts) AS negative_actual_intervals,count(*) FILTER(WHERE scheduled_expiry<start_ts) AS expiry_before_start FROM analysis.protection_episode
restriction_snapshot: SELECT pr_type,pr_level,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE pr_expiry<'2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS expired_before_nominal_cutoff,count(*) FILTER(WHERE pr_cascade) AS cascading FROM public.page_restrictions GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
creation_snapshot: SELECT pt_create_perm,count(*) AS titles,min(pt_timestamp) AS first_recorded,max(pt_timestamp) AS last_recorded,count(*) FILTER(WHERE pt_expiry<'2026-04-01 00:00:00+00') AS expired_before_nominal_cutoff FROM public.protected_titles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
event_types: SELECT restriction_type,level,count(*) AS opening_event_rows FROM analysis.protect_event WHERE is_opening GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
request_type_label_examples: SELECT rfpp_id,request_label,requested_action,requested_level,requested_intent->>'status' AS status FROM analysis.rfpp_request WHERE rfpp_id IN (33645,57453,106324,110347,176990,189060,202386) ORDER BY rfpp_id
